t: This is the pavilion at Lord's Cricket Ground, in St John's Wood. The ground was historically in Middlesex, and it now sits in the City of Westminster, in NW8. The pavilion is Grade II listed. It was designed by Thomas Verity, an English architect who worked during the theatre-building boom of 1885 to 1915. Verity lived from 1837 to 1891, and he was best known for theatres, which makes a cricket pavilion a slightly different commission from his usual work.
